title: Boneyard: Skeleton UI from Component Mapping
description:
Skeleton screens require maintaining a parallel version of your UI that breaks every time the real layout changes. Boneyard eliminates that by dynamically mapping your actual components and generating the loading placeholders automatically. No hardcoded heights, widths, or border radii. The skeleton stays in sync with the real UI because it derives directly from it.
